# Airgain® Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results


November 10, 2026 4:05pm EST


## Related Documents


[Earnings Webcast Q3 2026 Audio](https://event.choruscall.com/mediaframe/webcast.html?webcastid=1ZFXvKqA)


[10-Q Q3 2026 HTML](https://investors.airgain.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001193125-26-455520/airg-20260930.htm)[Download Raw XBRL Zip Files of 10-Q Q3 2026 XBRL Zip](https://investors.airgain.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001193125-26-455520/0001193125-26-455520-xbrl.zip)


**Q3 highlighted by strong sequential growth and continued momentum across enterprise IoT**


SAN DIEGO--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- **Airgain, Inc. (NASDAQ: AIRG)** , a leading provider of advanced wireless connectivity solutions, today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.


“Airgain delivered another strong quarter of progress, with revenue increasing 12% quarter-over-quarter and 9% year-over-year, driven by continued momentum in our enterprise IoT business,” **said Jacob Suen, President and CEO of Airgain** . “Our results reflect growing demand across established industrial applications, along with new opportunities in areas such as AI data center infrastructure. We are also making progress across AirgainConnect and Lighthouse as we continue expanding our portfolio of integrated wireless connectivity solutions. While near-term supply constraints continue to affect portions of our business, we remain focused on sustaining enterprise IoT momentum, converting opportunities across our growth platforms into revenue, and driving continued improvements in profitability.”


**Third Quarter 2026 and Recent Operational Highlights**


- Introduced Airgain RF Intelligence, an AI-powered platform with the aim to accelerate antenna design and unlock new market opportunities for Airgain's existing antenna portfolio.
- Secured two IoT design wins supporting AI data center infrastructure, expanding the use of Airgain's NimbeLink® embedded cellular modems in electrical energy monitoring and intelligent rack-level power management, with initial revenue expected in 2027.
- Demonstrated the effectiveness of Lighthouse™ 5G Intelligent Node in a Southern California residential community, improving cellular performance across all five measured locations, including achieving approximately 140 Mbps in an area where usable cellular data service was previously unavailable.
- Expanded AirgainConnect® engagement across public safety and critical field operations, leveraging its relationship with FirstNet®, Built with AT&T, including participation in the 2026 Vision FirstNet Users Summit.
- Appointed wireless industry veteran Stephan Memmen to the Board of Directors, bringing more than three decades of industry, operating, and strategic experience to support Airgain's continued growth.


**Third Quarter 2026 Financial Highlights**


**GAAP**


- Sales of $15.3 million
- GAAP gross margin of 41.8%
- GAAP operating expenses of $6.9 million
- GAAP net loss of $0.6 million or $(0.04) per share


**Non-GAAP**


- Non-GAAP gross margin of 42.4%
- Non-GAAP operating expenses of $6.0 million
- Non-GAAP net income of $0.5 million or $0.04 per share
- Adjusted EBITDA of $0.6 million


**Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results**


Sales for the third quarter of 2026 were $15.3 million, compared to $13.7 million in the second quarter of 2026 and $14.0 million in the third quarter of 2025. Third quarter 2026 sales consisted of $10.0 million from the enterprise market, $4.4 million from the consumer market, and $0.9 million from the automotive market. Sequentially, sales increased $1.6 million or 11.7%. Enterprise sales increased $3.3 million, driven by higher IoT modem shipments. Consumer sales decreased $1.4 million, driven by lower antenna shipments to cable and mobile network operators. Automotive sales decreased $0.3 million, driven by lower aftermarket antenna and vehicle gateway shipments. Compared to the third quarter of 2025, sales increased $1.3 million, or 9.3%, reflecting a $3.1 million increase in enterprise revenue and a $0.4 million increase in automotive revenue, partially offset by a $2.2 million decrease in consumer revenue.


GAAP gross profit for the third quarter of 2026 was $6.4 million, compared to $5.8 million for the second quarter of 2026 and $6.1 million for the same quarter a year ago. Non-GAAP gross profit for the third quarter of 2026 was $6.5 million, compared to $6.0 million for the second quarter of 2026 and $6.2 million for the same quarter a year ago (see note regarding "Use of Non-GAAP Financial Measures" below for further discussion of this non-GAAP measure).


GAAP gross margin for the third quarter of 2026 was 41.8%, compared to 42.3% for the second quarter of 2026 and 43.6% for the same quarter a year ago. The sequential decline primarily reflected an unfavorable shift in customer and product mix, driven by higher sales of lower-margin enterprise IoT products and reduced sales of higher-margin consumer products. Non-GAAP gross margin for the third quarter of 2026 was 42.4% compared to 43.6% for the second quarter of 2026 and 44.4% for the same quarter a year ago (see note regarding "Use of Non-GAAP Financial Measures" below for further discussion of this non-GAAP measure).


GAAP operating expenses for the third quarter of 2026 were $6.9 million, compared to $7.5 million for the second quarter of 2026 and $7.1 million for the same quarter a year ago. The sequential decrease was primarily due to the absence of severance expenses incurred in the second quarter, partially offset by higher employee-related expenses. Operating expenses decreased from the same quarter a year ago, primarily due to lower amortization of intangible assets, partially offset by higher employee-related expenses. Non-GAAP operating expenses for the third quarter of 2026 were $6.0 million, compared to $5.7 million in the second quarter of 2026 and $6.1 million for the same quarter a year ago (see note regarding "Use of Non-GAAP Financial Measures" below for further discussion of this non-GAAP measure).


GAAP net loss for the third quarter of 2026 was $0.6 million or ($0.04) per share (based on 13.1 million shares), compared to $1.7 million or ($0.13) per share (based on 12.8 million shares), for the second quarter of 2026 and $1.0 million, or ($0.08) per share (based on 11.8 million shares), for the same quarter a year ago. Non-GAAP net income for the third quarter of 2026 was $0.5 million, or $0.04 per share (based on 13.4 million diluted shares), compared to $0.3 million, or $0.02 per share (based on 13.2 million shares), for the second quarter of 2026 and $0.1 million, or $0.01 per share (based on 11.9 million shares), for the same quarter a year ago (see note regarding "Use of Non-GAAP Financial Measures" below for further discussion of this non-GAAP measure).


Adjusted EBITDA for the third quarter of 2026 was $0.6 million, compared to $0.4 million for the second quarter of 2026 and $0.3 million for the same quarter a year ago (see note regarding "Use of Non-GAAP Financial Measures" below for further discussion of this non-GAAP measure).


**Fourth Quarter 2026 Financial Outlook**


**GAAP**


- Sales are expected to be in the range of $15.5 million and $17.5 million, or $16.5 million at the midpoint
- GAAP gross margin is expected to be in the range of 39.2% to 42.2%
- GAAP operating expense is expected to be approximately $7.0 million
- GAAP net loss per share is expected to be $(0.02) per share at the midpoint


**Non-GAAP**


- Non-GAAP gross margin is expected to be in the range of 40.0% to 43.0%
- Non-GAAP operating expense is expected to be approximately $6.2 million
- Non-GAAP net income per share is expected to be $0.05 at the midpoint
- Adjusted EBITDA is expected to be $0.8 million at the midpoint


The Company's financial outlook for the three months ending December 31, 2026, including reconciliations of GAAP to non-GAAP measures can be found at the end of this press release.

**About Airgain, Inc.**


Headquartered in San Diego, California, Airgain, Inc. (NASDAQ: AIRG) is a leading provider of advanced wireless connectivity solutions that drive cutting-edge innovation in 5G technology. We are committed to delivering high-performance, cost-effective, and energy-efficient wireless solutions that enable rapid market deployment. Our mission is to connect the world through integrated, innovative, and optimized wireless solutions. Our diverse product portfolio serves three primary markets: enterprise, automotive, and consumer. For more information, visit[airgain.com](https://airgain.com/) , or follow us on[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/airgain/) and[X](https://twitter.com/Airgain) .


Airgain, AirgainConnect, and the Airgain logo are trademarks or registered trademarks of Airgain, Inc. All other trademarks are the property of their respective owner.

***Note Regarding Use of Non-GAAP Financial Measures***


*To supplement our financial statements presented in accordance with U.S. generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP), this earnings release and the accompanying tables and the related earnings conference call contain certain non-GAAP financial measures, including adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, amortization (Adjusted EBITDA), non-GAAP net income (loss) attributable to common stockholders (non-GAAP net income (loss)), non-GAAP net income (loss) per (basic or diluted) share (non-GAAP EPS), non-GAAP operating expense, non-GAAP gross profit and non-GAAP gross margin. We believe these financial measures provide useful information to investors with which to analyze our operating trends and performance.*


*In computing Adjusted EBITDA, non-GAAP net income (loss), and non-GAAP EPS, we exclude stock-based compensation expense, which represents non-cash charges for the fair value of stock awards; interest income, net of interest expense offset by other expense, depreciation and amortization, workforce reduction severance and exit costs, and provision (benefit) for income taxes. In computing non-GAAP operating expense, we exclude stock-based compensation expense, amortization of intangibles, workforce reduction severance, and exit costs. In computing non-GAAP gross profit and non-GAAP gross margin, we exclude stock-based compensation expense, and amortization of intangible assets. Because of varying available valuation methodologies, subjective assumptions, and the variety of equity instruments that can impact a company’s non-cash operating expenses; we believe that providing non-GAAP financial measures that exclude non-cash expense allows for meaningful comparisons between our core business operating results and those of other companies, as well as providing us with an important tool for financial and operational decision making and for evaluating our own core business operating results over different periods of time. Management considers these types of expenses and adjustments, to a great extent, to be unpredictable and dependent on a considerable number of factors that are outside of our control and are not necessarily reflective of operational performance during a period.*


*Our non-GAAP measures may not provide information that is directly comparable to that provided by other companies in our industry, as other companies in our industry may calculate non-GAAP financial results differently, particularly related to non-recurring, unusual items. Our Adjusted EBITDA, non-GAAP net income (loss), non-GAAP EPS, non-GAAP operating expense, non-GAAP gross profit and non-GAAP gross margin are not measurements of financial performance under GAAP and should not be considered as an alternative to operating or net income or as an indication of operating performance or any other measure of performance derived in accordance with GAAP. We do not consider these non-GAAP measures to be a substitute for, or superior to, the information provided by GAAP financial results. Reconciliations with specific adjustments to GAAP results and outlooks are provided at the end of this release.*
